_comment: Cooked dishes (soups, stews and porridges from a cooking pot, served in a bowl, pot or crock) add up their ingredients' nutrients per serving and then apply cookedMultipliers. Pies add up their contents and apply cookedMultipliers times their bake-state factor; raw pies get no cooking multipliers. Crocks with no recipe (pickles, for example) are summed as they are.
